capabilities: Export a note or folder to standalone HTML
Add a clickable table of contents and section navigator
Read exported HTML pages inside Obsidian
Underline selected text and attach reading notes
Sync annotations back to the source Markdown note
extras: Desktop-first release; annotation sync only runs when the HTML page is read inside Obsidian, while pages opened in a standalone browser keep only temporary marks.
motivation: Built for research, reviews, annual reflections and other long-form notes that deserve more room to breathe.
problem: Long-form notes are hard to read comfortably in the editor, and there is no built-in way to turn them into clean self-contained pages or mark passages while reading.
summary: Exports Markdown notes as standalone offline HTML reading pages with a table of contents, in-app reading and text annotations.
